person_outcome: A visitor or returning learner understands that Muchen Journey is a company-wide five-map People AI growth system, recognizes their current state, and takes one truthful next action without mistaking Exploration Camp for the whole product.

experience_states.required_behavior: Reveal a real invitation-link validation action without sending the visitor to an empty or dead /join state.
Open the learner growth hub or current map using verified session state.
Explain preserved progress and the operator-assisted recovery path without a loop.
Show the completed map, the unlocked next map, and the evidence continuity between them.

machine_acceptance.criterion: The first viewport presents the five-map People AI journey as the product; Exploration Camp appears as the current starting position, not the product identity.
Each supported state exposes exactly one executable primary action with no dead /join or /app transition.
The ordered maps and their growth outcomes are visible from one shared source of truth and do not conflict with map contracts.
At 390, 768, and 1280 CSS pixels the product promise, current state, and primary action are visible without horizontal overflow.
Keyboard, touch, reduced motion, loading, error, expired-session, and re-entry states retain a clear action without console errors or unsolicited authentication prefetch.
The candidate changes only controller-owned homepage files and does not create a second Person, Capability, Evidence, Progress, Identity, or map-state source.

human_acceptance.criterion: Without explanation, first-time participants can state that the product contains five connected growth maps, identify Exploration Camp as the current start, and name the next action within 10 seconds.
Participants do not describe Muchen Journey as only Exploration Camp or only an onboarding course.
Each participant independently takes the correct CTA for their assigned visitor or returning-learner state within 60 seconds.
Participants rate both visual attraction and willingness to continue into the current map.

integration_rule: Build and evaluate in an isolated worktree. Do not merge into the frozen Exploration Camp candidate or publish; hand the candidate to program control with evidence and compatibility notes.
